column1: # Locally-run MCP faces — the only known 2026-07-28 speakers in this corpus, and so
# probed first (per PREDICATES.md). Three shapes from one self-hosted runtime: a
# resources-only HTTP facade, and a stdio-to-HTTP bridge run twice — once with a
# modern child (an official-SDK server at mcp==2.0.0b1) and once in its legacy
# compatibility mode (child: npx server-memory@2026.7.4). The addresses are loopback
# and the runtime behind them is not what this corpus measures; what it measures is
# the wire behaviour recorded in the captures.
